name: ShopMetrics for WooCommerce
author: FinanciarMe

sections.description:
Stop Losing Money on Products You Think Are Profitable!

ShopMetrics reveals which products and marketing campaigns actually make you money (and which ones are secretly draining your profits). 73% of WooCommerce stores we analyzed were losing money on products they thought were profitable!

Key Features

🔍 Profit X-Ray Vision
* See your TRUE profit margins (not just revenue)
* Identify money-losing products before they kill your cash flow
* Factor in ALL costs: shipping, returns, payment fees, COGS

🛒 Smart Cart Recovery
* Recover 20-35% of abandoned carts automatically
* Intelligent email sequences that feel personal, not pushy
* Track which recovery methods make you the most money

📊 Marketing ROI Insights
* Know which ads bring profitable customers vs. bargain hunters
* Stop wasting money on campaigns that look good but lose money
* Double down on traffic sources that actually pay

💰 Cash Flow Prediction
* Never get caught with dead inventory again
* Know exactly what to stock and when
* Predict your cash flow 3 months ahead

⚡ Easy Setup
* Install in 30 seconds
* Connect your store in 2 minutes
* Get insights immediately

Perfect For

  • Stores doing $1-100K+ monthly who want to scale profitably
  • Merchants drowning in data but starving for insights
  • Anyone spending on ads but can’t prove what works
  • Business owners who want solid numbers they can trust

What Makes Us Different

Other plugins show you WHAT happened. We show you WHY it happened and WHAT TO DO about it.

  • Built for profit, not vanity metrics
  • Cloud-powered intelligence – Enterprise-level insights without enterprise prices
  • Made by store owners who understand your challenges
  • Proven results – Users average 22% profit increase in 90 days

Third Party Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide analytics, product improvement, and cloud-powered features:

  • Service: ShopMetrics Analytics Cloud (api.financiarme.es)

    • Purpose: Data processing, analytics computation, and secure data storage
    • Data Sent: Order data (when an order is placed or updated), cart events (when a cart is abandoned or recovered), and anonymized customer behavior (when users interact with the analytics dashboard)
    • When: Data is sent during order placement/updates, cart events, and when using the analytics dashboard
    • Terms: https://financiarme.es/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://financiarme.es/privacy

  • Service: PostHog (https://posthog.com)

    • Purpose: Product analytics to help us improve the plugin and user experience
    • Data Sent: Anonymized usage data, plugin events, and error reports (never customer or order data)
    • When: Only when you use the plugin admin dashboard or onboarding wizard
    • Terms: https://posthog.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://posthog.com/privacy

The connection to these services is essential for the plugin’s functionality and to help us improve the product. All data is encrypted and handled according to our privacy policy.

Support

For support, documentation, and feature requests:

  • Documentation: https://docs.financiarme.es/
  • Support Forum: Use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin
  • Website: https://financiarme.es/

Privacy Policy

ShopMetrics takes your privacy seriously. We collect and process data necessary to provide analytics insights while maintaining the highest standards of data protection. For full details, please see our privacy policy at https://financiarme.es/privacy
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.2 or greater
  • WooCommerce 3.0.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.2 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Automatic Installation

  1. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “ShopMetrics for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Follow the onboarding wizard to complete setup

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Follow the onboarding wizard to complete setup

After Installation

  1. Navigate to ShopMetrics in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Complete the quick onboarding process
  3. Configure your Cost of Goods Sold settings (optional)
  4. Start exploring your analytics dashboard!
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated. It’s specifically designed to work with WooCommerce stores.

Do I need a ShopMetrics account?

The plugin automatically creates a secure connection to our analytics cloud during setup. No separate account registration is required.

Will this slow down my website?

No! The plugin is designed to be lightweight and uses background processes for data synchronization. Your store’s performance won’t be affected.

Can I export my data?

Yes, you can export your analytics data in various formats directly from the dashboard.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely! We use enterprise-grade encryption and follow strict security protocols to protect your data. We are fully GDPR compliant.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your data remains safely stored in our cloud for 30 days. If you reactivate the plugin during that time, all your historical data will be available again.

Do you offer support?

Yes! We provide comprehensive support through our documentation and support team.

Can I customize the dashboard?

The dashboard is designed to be comprehensive out of the box. We’re continuously adding new features based on user feedback.

Does this work with other WordPress ecommerce plugins?

Currently, ShopMetrics is designed specifically for WooCommerce. Support for other ecommerce platforms may be added in future versions.

What currencies are supported?

ShopMetrics supports all currencies that WooCommerce supports. Multi-currency stores are fully supported.
